description: This file defines the `ExecCommandResolution` struct and associated static methods for resolving command paths, parsing shell commands, tokenizing, and handling execution environments within a security or command execution context. It includes logic for resolving commands from raw input, environment variables, and handling complex shell syntax.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A structure representing the resolved executable command with methods to perform various resolution strategies and parsing logic.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a command based on input parameters, returning an `ExecCommandResolution` if successful.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands in a way suitable for an allowlist, parsing shell wrappers if present.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Generates allowlist patterns for commands that should always be allowed.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable path from a raw command string, expanding tilde and searching PATH if necessary.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves executable path from a segment of a shell command.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns for commands that should always be allowed.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Identifies and unwraps shell multiplexer commands like busybox or toybox wrappers.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token from a command string, handling quotes.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Tokenizes a shell command string into arguments, respecting shell quoting and escaping.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command chain into individual segments based on delimiters, respecting shell syntax.

methods.name: searchPaths
methods.description: Retrieves the search paths for executables from environment variables or defaults.
